title: May well, might as well, would sooner
summary: Modal nâng cao: may/might well (khá có khả năng), might as well (thì cứ… đi), would sooner/would rather, could have done with (giá mà có).

dialogue.en: The next bus is in forty minutes.
dialogue.vi: Chuyến xe buýt tiếp theo còn bốn mươi phút nữa.
Vậy mình đi bộ luôn cho rồi.

dialogue.en: It [[may well]] rain, though. Look at the sky.
dialogue.vi: Nhưng khá có khả năng trời mưa đấy. Nhìn trời kìa.

dialogue.en: I'[[d sooner]] get wet than wait here.
dialogue.vi: Mình thà ướt còn hơn đứng chờ ở đây.

dialogue.en: I [[could have done with]] an umbrella!
dialogue.vi: Giá mà có cái ô thì tốt!
Lẽ ra bạn nên nói sớm hơn chứ!

sections.heading: May well / might well / could well
sections.rule: **may / might / could + well + V** = **khá có khả năng** (mạnh hơn may đơn thuần).

examples.vi: Giá rất có thể sẽ tăng nữa.

check.prompt: The meeting ___ well finish late. Don't wait for me.
check.explain: May well = khá có khả năng.

sections.heading: Might as well / may as well
sections.rule: **might / may as well + V** = **thì cứ… luôn đi** (vì không có lựa chọn nào tốt hơn).

examples.en: There's nothing on TV. We [[might as well]] go to bed.
examples.vi: Tivi chẳng có gì. Đi ngủ luôn cho rồi.
examples.why: Không có gì tốt hơn → might as well.

examples.en: It's free, so you [[may as well]] take one.
examples.vi: Miễn phí mà, lấy một cái đi.

check.prompt: The shop is closed, so we ___ as well go home.

sections.heading: Would sooner, could have done with, might have
sections.rule: **would sooner / would rather + V** = thà… hơn. **could have done with + danh từ** = giá mà có (thì tốt). **might have + V3** = lẽ ra nên (trách nhẹ).

examples.en: I'[[d sooner]] stay home than go out in this rain.
examples.vi: Tôi thà ở nhà còn hơn ra ngoài trời mưa thế này.

examples.en: I [[could have done with]] more time.
examples.vi: Giá mà tôi có thêm thời gian.
examples.why: Could have done with + danh từ.

examples.vi: Lẽ ra bạn nên báo trước cho tôi chứ!

check.prompt: That exam was hard. I could have done ___ another week to study.

mistakes.wrong: We might as well to walk.
mistakes.why: Might as well + V nguyên mẫu.

mistakes.wrong: I'd sooner to stay at home.
It may well to rain later.
I could have done without a coffee; I was so tired.
mistakes.right: I could have done with a coffee; I was so tired.

exercises.prompt: The train is late again. We ___ as well get a coffee.
He ___ well be the best player in the team.
I'd sooner walk ___ take that crowded bus.
I'm exhausted. I could have done ___ a longer holiday.
Câu nào là lời trách nhẹ?
Nobody else wants it, so you ___ as well take it.
I'd ___ stay here than go to that party.
You might have ___ me you were coming!

exercises.vi: Vậy mình đi bộ luôn cho rồi.
Giá mà tôi có thêm thời gian.

exercises.sentence: We may as well to leave now.
answers: We may as well leave now.

exercises.sentence: I'd sooner die than to apologize.

exercises.vi: Rất có thể anh ấy đã quên.
answers: It's quite possible that he has forgotten.
He may well have forgotten about it.

exercises.vi: Tôi thà đi bộ còn hơn chờ xe buýt.
answers: I'd sooner walk than wait for the bus.
I would sooner walk than wait for the bus.
I'd rather walk than wait for the bus.
I would rather walk than wait for the bus.
I'd sooner walk than wait for a bus.
